title: Data Analyst
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Data Analyst for our Data team (Berlin, Germany (hybrid)).

What you will do
- Build dashboards and reports for business teams
- Define and document metrics with stakeholders
- Answer business questions with clear analysis

What you bring
- At least 2 years of relevant experience
- Solid working knowledge of Data Visualization, pandas, Power BI, Python and Excel

Nice to have
- Data Cleaning, Stakeholder Communication, Looker and Dashboards
